name: British Columbia maximum allowable rent increase (2026 and 2027)
description: Annual cap on rent increases for existing tenancies, tied to BC CPI.

attributes.notice: at least three full months' written notice on Form RTB-7
attributes.above_cap: only with tenant's written agreement or an RTB-approved additional increase

sources.title: Rent increases (last updated 27 August 2026)
sources.publisher: Province of British Columbia — Residential Tenancy Branch
sources.licence: Province of British Columbia; Copyright and Disclaimer of gov.bc.ca (link and cite; reproduction terms per gov.bc.ca copyright page)

limitations: Applies to existing tenancies; rent between tenancies is not capped (vacancy decontrol is not stated on the page — verify).
